documents.title: Bambu PLA Matte Technical Data Sheet V3.0
Bambu PLA Matte Safety Data Sheet SDS20250724A01
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: PLA Matte
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values; the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 22 ± 4 MPa, elongation 4.8 ± 1.7 %, bending modulus 1770 ± 210 MPa, bending strength 29 ± 5 MPa, impact 6.6 ± 1.1 kJ/m²) are not stored.

Printed-specimen results and raw-material properties stay apart: mechanical.* holds only printed-specimen values (with the specimen printing conditions in test_condition); material.density, thermal.melting_temp and thermal.glass_transition are material properties (ISO 1183, DSC). The TDS does not say how the Vicat (ISO 306) and HDT (ISO 75) specimens were made (its Specimen Test drawings cover tensile, bending and impact only); their test_condition says so. The registry has no separate *.printed / *.material keys.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 1960 ± 180 MPa, Z 1670 ± 140 MPa), melt index (18.0 ± 3.2 g/10 min at 210 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature (N/A), saturated water absorption rate (0.40 % at 25 °C, 55% RH), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH, sealed with desiccant), bed surface preparation (glue), retraction length (0.6 - 1.0 mm) and speed (20 - 40 mm/s), chamber temperature (25 - 45 °C), max overhang angle (55°), max bridging length (30 mm), spool material (ABS, temperature resistance 70 °C) and spool size (diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm), suggested annealing (50 - 60 °C, 6 - 12 h), odor, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products rows.

The TDS recommended chamber temperature (p.2: "Chamber Temperature 25 - 45 °C") is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a single number whose template field is chamber_temp_max (a printer's maximum chamber temperature, the form the printer files store), and no filament file of this class stores the TDS recommendation there.

The SDS model "A01-xx" (p.2, section 1: "Model : A01-xx(xx stands for any suffix)") is not stored: identity.model is written from the reviewed identity map ("PLA Matte", §C.1), which a curated official_doc row would outrank and replace, and "A01-xx" is a designation with a wildcard suffix, not this product's model, so it must not become a search alias. SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: CLP "Not classified", and "Not hazardous goods" for sea, road and air transport. Its section 9 "No data available" for melting point and density does not override the TDS values.

Source disagreements kept for review: nozzle temperature (TDS 190 - 230 °C vs material-table wiki 190 - 240 °C ±10 °C for PLA*); bed temperature on the High Temperature and Textured PEI plates (TDS 35 - 45 °C for all three bed types vs material-table wiki 45 - 65 ℃); oven drying temperature (TDS and drying wiki 50 °C vs material-table wiki 55 ℃ for PLA); HDT (PLA wiki 57°C for PLA in general vs TDS 52 °C at 1.8 MPa and 58 °C at 0.45 MPa). The product TDS values are kept.
Marketing prose proves no number: "up to 250-300 mm/s" (TDS Basic Info and store meta description) and "up to 270 mm/s*" (store page) are not stored.
Hex: the hex table writes "Lilac Purple"; the store value is "Lilac purple (11700)". Matched case-insensitively; every one of the 25 store colours has exactly one hex cell.

The store page links certificate PDFs that were not cached and not read: Filament RoHS (https://store.bblcdn.com/0d30076831474a6c9bfc8fe96e0df8d1.pdf), SVHC, PAHs, TSCA, POPs, CP65 and EN71-3. They are lab test reports, so safety.certifications holds only the store page's own UL GREENGUARD claim (unverified) and is not marked not_published.
The store page also links the wiki guide https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/general/swaping-new-filament-with-bambu-reusable-spool, which was not cached and not read.
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament.

material.spool_type is not curated: the store page has no spool bullet (its Type values "Refill" / "Filament with spool" are the deterministic layer's), and the TDS Spool Material (ABS, temperature resistance 70 °C) and Spool Size (diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm) rows give the spool's material and size, not its type; no registry key holds them.

Adjudication against the second extraction (147 field disagreements; every cited cached document re-read): the locator wording of the TDS rows, the 25 hex cells and the relations keeps this file's form ("p.N, Section › Row"), and every hex cell was re-checked against the hex table (name, row, column and code). thermal.heat_deflection_temp stays the TDS 1.8 MPa row (52 °C), the load every other filament file stores; the 0.45 MPa row (58 °C, the second extraction's value) is in its note. safety.certifications keeps the bullet's own words "UL GREENGUARD 2904" (the second extraction's "UL GREENGUARD (UL 2904)" is the page's description block making the same claim). material.net_weight is written as 1 kg, the TDS's own figure (the quote checker flagged 1000 g against the quote "1 kg"); the merge stores 1000 g either way. Added from the second extraction: extrusion.supported_nozzle_diameters (the TDS Nozzle Size row, as in the PLA Metal, PLA Pure and ABS files). Not added: material.spool_type (see above), thermal.chamber_temp (see above), identity.model (see above) and compat.statement (a join of the PLA wiki row's three cells, whose "All printers compatible" sits under the "Print Bed Compatibility (Description)" column; the row's AMS and nozzle facts and the material table's printer row are relations here). Relations keep this file's form, as in the PLA Basic and PLA Metal files: one AMS-series family relation (PLA wiki) for the second extraction's AMS and AMS lite relations (material-table wiki "PLA* | Compatible"), one "Open-frame or enclosed printer" family relation for its two printer-class relations, one standard-nozzle relation (TDS) and one high-flow-nozzle relation (material-table wiki) for its seven per-nozzle relations, and the refill's requires-spool relation in the page's own word "spool" with the Bambu Reusable Spool as its target, the form the package itself writes. Added after reading the material-table wiki and the TDS: compatible_with high-flow nozzles (0.4, 0.6, 0.8 mm) and compatible_with Support for PLA.
